info.title: Submerge Crystal API v1
info.description:
REST API for Submerge Crystal, the core indexer component of Submerge.

Submerge API endpoints are grouped under five resource sets:
- Blocks
- Calls
- Events
- Extrinsics
- Genesis
- Metadata
- Traces

Public API is limited by 5 requests per second.
Request query parameters use `snake_case`; response fields use `camelCase`.

servers.description: API preview deployment for Polkadot Coretime.
Submerge Crystal production API per deployed chain.

get.description: Returns all blocks from the database that satisfy the query parameters. It will return a paginated response, ordered descending by block number.

parameters.description: Block list page number to retrieve. 1-indexed.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of blocks per page to be returned.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter results by block status. If not specified, all blocks are returned.

parameters.name: min_block_number
parameters.description: Filter blocks by minimum block number.

parameters.name: max_block_number
parameters.description: Filter blocks by maximum block number.

parameters.name: min_block_timestamp
parameters.description: Filter blocks by minimum block timestamp. In milliseconds.

parameters.name: max_block_timestamp
parameters.description: Filter blocks by maximum block timestamp. In milliseconds.

parameters.name: min_spec_version
parameters.description: Filter blocks by minimum runtime spec version.

parameters.name: max_spec_version
parameters.description: Filter blocks by maximum runtime spec version.

parameters.name: author
parameters.description:
Filter results by block author. Either of the following:
- Author's Substrate SS58 address string (e.g. `5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY`).
- Author's Substrate account id encoded as a hex string (e.g. `0x008d8404893c7b4b80f397605cc96e61fec3c89676c8c2794a2a7d281d678b1a`).
- Author's address encoded as a hex string with optional `0x` prefix (e.g. `0x008d8404893c7b4b80f397605cc96e61fec3c89676c8c2794a2a7d281d678b1a`).

AccountIdHex.description: 32-byte Substrate account id as lowercase hex, **always** `0x`-prefixed and lowercase in responses.

Address20Hex.description: 20-byte address as lowercase hex, **always** `0x`-prefixed and lowercase in responses.

Address32Hex.description: 32-byte address as lowercase hex, **always** `0x`-prefixed and lowercase in responses.

eventCount.description: Number of events in the block.

extrinsicCount.description: Number of extrinsics in the block.

stateRoot.description: Root hash of the state trie after executing this block.

weight.description: Block weight in JSON format. Schema depends on runtime metadata.

BlockStatus.description:
Block status.
- `finalized`: Blocks that have been finalized on chain.
- `proposed`: Blocks that have been authored but not yet finalized.
- `pruned`: Blocks that have been removed or are no longer accessible.

blockTimestamp.description: Timestamp of the call's block. Milliseconds.

callIndex.description: Index of the call, represented as an unsigned integer array.

callPath.description: Rust-style path of the call represented with parameter names or indices.

extrinsicIsSuccessful.description:
Whether the call's extrinsic was successful.
Note: The extrinsic can be successful where the call has failed (see the `Utility.ForceBatch`` call).

palletCallIndex.description: Index of the call in its pallet.

parentCallHash.description: Hash of the parent call if this call is a nested call (batch, multisig, etc.).

specVersion.description: Runtime spec version of the call's block.

args.description: Call arguments in JSON format. Schema depends on runtime metadata and the call.

blockTimestamp.description: Timestamp of the event's block. Milliseconds.

extrinsicHash.description: Hash of the event's extrinsic, if it was output from an extrinsic.

extrinsicIndex.description: Index of the event's extrinsic, if it was output from an extrinsic.

index.description: Index of the event in block.

palletEventIndex.description: Index of the event in its pallet.

specVersion.description: Runtime spec version of the event's block.

traceIndex.description: Index of the event's trace, if traces are enabled.

args.description: Event arguments in JSON format. Schema depends on runtime metadata and the event.

Extrinsic.description: An extrinsic in a block. Signed or unsigned.

blockTimestamp.description: Timestamp of the extrinsic's block. Milliseconds.

extra.description: Extrinsic extras in JSON format - checkNonce, checkGenesis, chargeTransactionPayment, etc.

specVersion.description: Runtime spec version of the extrinsic's block.

GenesisRecord.description: A storage item initialized at genesis.

keyParams.description: Storage item key parameter(s) for the genesis record.

keyPrefix.description: Storage item key prefix for the genesis record.

knownKey.description: If the record is a known UTF-8 key, the string representation of the key.

palletIndex.description: If the record is a storage item, the storage item's pallet index in the metadata.

palletName.description: If the record is a storage item, the storage item's pallet name in the metadata.

palletStorageItemIndex.description: If the record is a storage item, the storage item's index in the pallet metadata.

palletStorageItemName.description: If the record is a storage item, the storage item's name.

Hash256Hex.description:
32-byte Blake2b-256, **always** `0x`-prefixed and lowercase in responses.
Inputs elsewhere may accept mixed case or missing `0x`; the API normalizes outputs.

HexString.description: Arbitrary hex-encoded bytes. Lowercase, even length, `0x`-prefixed.

MultiAddress.description:
Discriminated union for the Substrate multi-address type.
The `type` tag selects the variant; `value` carries the payload.

MultiSignature.description:
Discriminated union for the Substrate multi-signature type.
The `type` tag selects the variant; `value` carries the payload.

total.description: Total number of items across all pages.

SignatureHexString.description:
and ECDSA (65 bytes → 130 hex chars). **Always** `0x`-prefixed and lowercase in responses.
Inputs elsewhere may accept mixed case or missing `0x`; the API normalizes outputs.

PaginatedGenesisRecordList.description: Paginated list of genesis record items.
